svg.text: Pool 4 | SELECT 1 AS x | prepare: false | Deno 2.9.7 | 8 s / stage | No warmup
CPU / QPS: actual interval averages, no smoothing. CPU 100% = one logical core; server excluded.
Concurrency targets overlap. Each run retains one pool across stages; single-run comparison, not independent steady states.
